name: MitoEM 2.0
description: A benchmark dataset for challenging 3D mitochondria instance segmentation from electron microscopy (EM) image volumes.
evaluation_method: average precision (AP) / IoU / Dice (instance segmentation metrics)
reputation: A recognized benchmark in the connectomics/EM segmentation community for challenging 3D mitochondria instance segmentation, used in follow-up methods research.
notes: Non-LLM medical imaging benchmark requiring 3D volumetric data and substantial compute; specialized to mitochondria (domain-specific), moderate dataset size; evaluation sensitive to segmentation post-processing and IoU thresholds.
